recognize_zh: 這是 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤治療流程圖（非型態圖）：依局限鼻型、局限非鼻型與瀰漫性分流；局限鼻型能接受化療者用化放療合併（夾心式或同步），不適合化療者單純放療；非鼻型與瀰漫性用含 L-asparaginase 的 SMILE 方案，完全緩解可考慮造血幹細胞移植。
features: Entry point: newly diagnosed NK/T-cell lymphoma split into localized nasal, localized non-nasal, and disseminated disease
Localized nasal, chemotherapy fit: sequential chemoradiotherapy (SMILE or LVP with sandwiched RT) or concurrent chemoradiotherapy (2/3 DeVIC with RT, or RT plus cisplatin followed by VIPD)
Localized nasal, chemotherapy unfit: radiotherapy alone
Localized non-nasal and disseminated disease: systemic SMILE with or without RT, with consideration of HSCT in complete remission
Relapsed/refractory disease: SMILE with or without RT or L-asparaginase-containing regimens with non-MDR-dependent drugs, considering HSCT if CR
describe_en: This figure is a non-morphologic treatment algorithm for extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma. Patients with localized nasal disease who are fit for chemotherapy receive combined-modality therapy, either sequential (SMILE or LVP with sandwiched radiotherapy) or concurrent (2/3 DeVIC with radiotherapy, or radiotherapy with cisplatin followed by VIPD), while unfit patients receive radiotherapy alone. Localized non-nasal and disseminated disease are treated with systemic SMILE with or without radiotherapy, with hematopoietic stem cell transplantation considered in complete remission. Relapsed or refractory disease is treated with SMILE or other L-asparaginase-based regimens using drugs not affected by P-glycoprotein-mediated multidrug resistance, again with HSCT considered upon complete remission.
